title: Keto Turkish Kazandibi with Herring
description: A unique keto dessert that combines the flavors of Turkey with the richness of herring.
instructions: Bake the kazandibi according to the package instructions.
In a blender, mix the cream cheese, honey, eggs, sweetener, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Once the kazandibi is done, let it cool for a few minutes.
Cut the kazandibi into small pieces and place them in a baking dish.
Pour the cream cheese mixture over the kazandibi.
Bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the mixture is set.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Sprinkle with almond flour if desired.
Garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
